definitions.n_items: non-empty lines of the file (one item / document per line)
definitions.n_texts: string fields read (every string value of a JSONL record; the line for plain text)
definitions.n_word_tokens: regex word tokens over the NFC text
definitions.n_syllable_tokens: word tokens that parse as a Vietnamese syllable
definitions.affected_tokens: syllable tokens whose tone-mark placement differs between the conventions (what C2 changes)
definitions.affected_items: lines with at least one affected token
